residual_effect_per_fill._what: change in residual quantity caused by the fill. Negative = compressing, positive = accumulating directional risk.

counterfactual_remove_taker_fills._what: each window replayed twice with FIFO pairing -- as it happened, and with TAKER_OBSERVED fills removed. Positive means the aggressive fills ADDED P&L.
counterfactual_remove_taker_fills._assumption: that the maker fills would still have arrived had L5 not aggressed. Stated, not demonstrated.

item4_prediction._design: chronological 70/30 split by window; no window spans the boundary; the test set is strictly later in time.

models.M1: + log residual qty, residual VWAP, fraction of window remaining, current leg

item4_prediction.VERDICT: execution-mode features DO improve out-of-sample prediction
item4_prediction._reconciliation: A flat hazard and a real two-mode structure are compatible. Mode governs the PRICE, SIZE and TIMING of a fill. The flat hazard governs WHICH LEG comes next. These are different questions, and this item tests only the second.
